definitions.arithmetic: float64 NumPy over saved physical float32 WSS arrays
definitions.degradation_ratio: S1 extreme-test case mean / S1 ID-reference case mean
definitions.group_summary: arithmetic mean over case metrics, matching infer.py summary aggregation; a separately labeled pooled-over-points value is also retained
definitions.historical_wss_l2: mean_i(||pred_i - true_i||_2 / (||true_i||_2 + eps)); the producing evaluator applied its last-axis reduction to an (N,3) tensor
definitions.weighting: unweighted; no cell-area or target-measure weighting

degradation_differential.ordering: lower extreme/ID degradation ratio is better
degradation_differential.statistical_scope: Descriptive 5-vs-5 range separation only. Shared seed labels and identical evaluation targets do not by themselves declare a paired or independent inferential sampling model.

historical_evaluator_semantics.comment_code_mismatch: the historical MetricCalculator comment called the aggregate flattened/Frobenius, but passed p and t without flattening
historical_evaluator_semantics.consequence: bare wss_l2 was a pointwise-mean vector-relative error
